authorization_rule: compile is permitted only when every machine check reports satisfied=true

blockers.machine_check: git merge-base --is-ancestor <source_commit> origin/agent-main and bind the merge SHA in source-provenance.json
source-provenance.json must bind the pinned revision/config/index, 48 exact routed shard headers, 72317 tensors, zero orphan/missing/misrouted keys, and every LFS object SHA-256
rank-inventory.json plus 32 dsv4-streaming-rank-v1 manifests must cover ranks 0..31, bind unique inventory and checkpoint SHA-256 values, TP=32, BF16 outputs, and <=67108864 observed writer chunks
compiler-provenance.json must bind image/config digests and exact neuronx-cc, torch-neuronx, NxDI, NxD, NKI, torch and runtime package/source identities

cpu-reference-manifest.json must bind campaign-canonical-v1 prompt hash 99f702c72d2fafcc, four prompts x ten token IDs, 40 full-vocabulary FP32 logit artifacts, exact checkpoint/tokenizer identity and canonical manifest SHA-256
emitted-contract.json must exactly equal topology and emitted_contract above and reject missing/extra/drifted fields before compile
